_about: Local-rights status per team for the late-binding local row (spec 3.12). TBA_NO_RIGHTS_HOLDER = the club holds its local rights and has announced no distributor; UNANNOUNCED = a distributor exists but this game's local row is not yet in the league file; CONFIRMED = a distributor is announced (outlet/surface/label take effect; the row renders as a normal service, no CARRIER TBA plate). simulcasts lists hand-entered OTA simulcast games (matched by ET date + opponent tricode, source-agnostic). Update when carriers are announced (Tier 1 research task, docs/research/research-changelog.md).

simulcasts.source: WOIO/WUAB announcement, 2026-09-15 (https://www.cleveland19.com/2026/09/15/cleveland-cavaliers-games-return-free-over-the-air-television-19-news/): the package is "a simulcast of the games available for free in front of the Cavaliers on DAZN paid subscription paywall offering". Joe confirms this is the complete list, not a first tranche. TWO CORRECTIONS TO THE ARTICLE ON JOE'S AUTHORITY: it prints "Cleveland and Phoenix" for February 14, which is Phoenix AT Cleveland, and "Cleveland at DC", which is WAS.
simulcasts.note: 15 games per season free on DAZN and simulcast over the air. THE OUTLET IS PER GAME, not per package: thirteen of the fifteen are on WOIO, two are WUAB 43 only, and four are on both - one `outlet` field could not say that. Games are matched by ET date + opponent tricode, source-agnostic. DAL, DET and CHA EACH APPEAR TWICE, so the tricode alone is not a key and no matcher may treat it as one. `side` is the announcement's own home/away and is provenance, not part of the match key.
simulcasts.outletNote: WOIO is CBS's Cleveland station (data/row_order.json: network CBS, station WOIO, channel 19), which is why it is deliberately NOT an entry in data/access_profile.json - it resolves as CBS. WUAB 43 is its own network there and already carries RESN/DAZN inside its mark. How a simulcast row resolves its access, and how the two stations render, is prompt 105's question: prompt 104 lands the data and the artwork only, and adapters/nba.py emits no simulcast row yet.
simulcasts.confirmed: Joe, 2026-09-16 (public announcement 2026-09-15; the complete list, not a first tranche)
